input.summary: Add an ownership clause: AP retains all rights in its Content, Properties and Customer Data and owns deliverables, with Kubient retaining its platform and granting a licence-back to embedded materials.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement never says who owns the content, data and work product we put in or pay for, so we have added a short ownership clause confirming we retain our Content, Properties and Customer Data and own deliverables, with Kubient keeping the Auction Platform and its background technology plus a licence-back for anything of its own embedded in deliverables. This reflects our standard position that we own what we fund and what we contribute, with no assignment to Kubient and no joint ownership.

ops.text: (b) Ownership of Content, Data and Deliverables. As between the Parties, Customer owns and retains all right, title and interest in and to the Content, the Properties, the Requests and all other data and information provided by, collected from or generated on behalf of Customer, its users or the Properties (collectively, "Customer Data"), together with all deliverables and work product created for Customer under this Agreement or any Exhibit, and Kubient hereby assigns to Customer all right, title and interest in and to such deliverables and work product. Kubient retains all right, title and interest in the Auction Platform and its pre-existing and generally applicable technology, tools and know-how, and grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense any Kubient materials embedded in such deliverables for Customer's business purposes. Nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to Kubient any ownership interest in Customer Data or any other Customer intellectual property, no deliverable or Customer Data shall be jointly owned, and Kubient may use Customer Data solely as necessary to provide the Services.
